messages:
Ava (Support): Customer reports promo code was accepted in the UI and they got the confirmation email, but org balance is still 0. Org: org_9c8b7a. Billing profile shown in UI: bill_77. Customer says they clicked Redeem around 2026-03-12 14:12 UTC.
Jason (Engineer): Can you paste the redeem response and any request ids? also any webhook delivery ids from the promo service.
Ava (Support): Redeem API returned 200/accepted. Payload we recorded:
```
POST /v1/promos/redeem
{ "code": "ACME-TRIAL-200", "org_id": "org_9c8b7a" }
Response 200
{ "status": "accepted", "claim_id": "cl_0x9f3", "amount": 20000 }
```
But balance stayed 0. Confirmation email included claim_id cl_0x9f3. Customer screenshot attached in ticket.
Priya (Billing): Quick check: did the ledger write happen? I don't see a ledger event for cl_0x9f3. Can you include promo-service webhook delivery log?
Ava (Support): Copied the webhook delivery entries we have from promo-service logs:
```
[2026-03-12T14:12:05Z] POST /internal/ledger/apply 200 OK trace=trc_led_121
body: {"claim_id":"cl_0x9f3","apply_to":"invoice_profile","invoice_profile_id":"bill_77","amount":20000}
[2026-03-12T14:12:06Z] ledger response: {"status":"skipped","reason":"org-not-mapped-to-billing-profile"}
```
Jason (Engineer): aha — promo-service applied to invoice_profile rather than org balance. That ledger response suggests the mapping from org_9c8b7a -> bill_77 didn't exist at write time. Is bill_77 active?
Ava (Support): According to account UI, bill_77 exists but is linked to a different tenant in our billing system (looks like a legacy migration edge case). The customer was onboarded via partner SSO, might be mapped to a subaccount.
Eran (Support): Repro steps we should run: 1) redeem code on org_9c8b7a in staging of promo-service with same promo config; 2) inspect mapping lookup in billing-mapper service for org_9c8b7a; 3) re-run ledger apply. Can someone from billing confirm whether a manual posting is safe?
Priya (Billing): Manual posting is fine for this amount. Need confirmation from customer and a ticket for billing-ops to post a journal entry and reconcile. Also we should patch promo-service to fall back to org-apply path when invoice_profile mapping missing.
Ava (Support): Customer is fine with manual credit. They want ETA. Contact: lisa@acmecorp.com. They also provided their org owner id user_acme_23.
Jason (Engineer): I'll add a short defensive change: if ledger returns skipped:mapping, promo-service will queue an internal retry with different apply_to (org_id) and emit an alert. Low-risk hotfix.
Priya (Billing): Escalated to billing-ops. Ticket INC-4321 created, assigned to @billing-ops. ETA for manual post: within 24h business hours.
PromoBot: promo-service delivered webhook trc_led_121 -> ledger returned skipped at 2026-03-12T14:12:06Z (code: ORG_MAPPING_MISSING).
Ava (Support): Thanks — I'll update the customer with ticket INC-4321 and ETA. We'll keep this thread updated if we see similar cases. :thumbsup:
